RECON (silverish-parodic-quoll / cache+temp): ticket's guessed path WRONG. Real exemplar is
src/rebar/llm/workflow/completion_verdict_cache.py::persist_pass_verdicts (not llm/completion_cache.py).
DECISIVE: src/rebar/_store/fsutil.py::atomic_write ALREADY EXISTS (118 LOC, stdlib-only leaf, ~50
callers) and already implements mkstemp-in-dir -> write -> os.replace with unlink-on-error. So this
leaf is CONVERSION of hazard sites to the existing helper, NOT authoring a new helper/module.
6 SHARED-NAME-HAZARD sites: review_bot/reconcile.py:177 _write_cursor; _config_writer.py:279;
_cli/__init__.py:253; _opcert_signing.py:77 (pid-derived name -> collides across THREADS in the
threaded MCP server); _snapshot/janitor.py:300 (no temp at all); llm/workflow/completion_banking.py:507
(no temp; run-scoped dir mitigates collision but torn-read window remains).
Module-level caches audited: NONE is a root-unkeyed hazard (all keyed by path/root/stat-token).
Test pattern: model on the exemplar's own regression tests/unit/workflow/test_completion_verdict_cache.py:487
(threading.Barrier(2) + monkeypatch os.replace at the real seam, assert both writers land + no *.tmp
residue). The two harnesses the ticket named are the wrong shape (store_concurrency = subprocess storm;
sync_contention_harness = sync/freshness, no two-writer barrier).

RECON (washedup-ropeable-hammerkop / isolation guard): pytest_collection_modifyitems ALREADY EXISTS
at tests/conftest.py:220 (3 arms). Arm (c) precedent is load-bearing: from the xdist CONTROLLER a
collection failure must raise pytest.UsageError, NOT pytest.fail (which escapes as a 20-line
INTERNALERROR - 'a guard whose whole value is a clear message must not look like a crash').
AST census of unit tier: 866 spawn sites / 334 files; ~841 legitimate. HAZARDS only ~26:
3 fresh-literal env= dicts w/o os.environ or REBAR_ROOT; 22-23 cwd=REPO_ROOT; 1 git -C REPO_ROOT;
1 operator HOME read. ~58 env=<bare var> sites are statically UNDECIDABLE -> must report, not fail
(failing them would redden 42 files day one). Regex disqualified: asyncio.run alone = 126 false
positives. Must exempt tests/_nested_pytest.py's 4 documented exceptions. NO precedent for a
reason-bearing marker: --strict-markers validates the NAME only, so reason enforcement is hand-rolled.

RECON (floaty-imperfect-pomeranian / measurement): BLOCKER-SHAPED FINDING - reports/ is GITIGNORED
(.gitignore:111 '/reports/'), and nothing under reports/ has ever been committed. Two tickets
(this one AC1-3, and yogic-soapstone-takin AC1) require COMMITTED reports/stability/*.md. Fix must
be '/reports/*' + '!/reports/stability/' because git will not descend into an excluded directory.
This creates a real ordering dependency between two nominally order-independent siblings: the FIRST
report ticket to land carries the .gitignore change; the second inherits it via the stack.
Decision: land yogic-soapstone-takin first (simplest) and give it the .gitignore edit.
Other: evidence base .scratch/stability-analysis/ exists ONLY in main checkout (not committed,
not in worktree) - readable read-only at /Users/joeoakhart/rebar/.scratch/stability-analysis/.
backtest imports BUGFIX_SIZE_THRESHOLD_NON_TEST_LINES + escalation_for_diff from
rebar.llm.code_review.bugfix_size_gate (anti-drift); computes NO correlation today (only recall).
Doubling window = 2026-08-25..2026-08-30 (newer-30 half of R2S3's 60 session logs).
R2S1/R2S3 raw samples NOT committed but reproducible (seed 20260831, method recorded).
Negative-vote/rework data is Gerrit-REST-only; cheapest proxy = patchset count via o=ALL_REVISIONS.
Next ADR number = 0110 (docs/adr/.numbers/ highest is 0109); index docs/adr/README.md is GENERATED
by scripts/gen_adr_index.py - never hand-edit.
